Shipping Cost Estimator

Compare dimensional weight vs actual weight and price it across your own zone rates.

–
Dimensional weight
–
Chargeable weight

You are charged on the greater of actual and dimensional weight. For information only — not financial advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose metric or imperial units and enter the parcel dimensions and actual weight.
  2. Set the dimensional divisor (5000 for cm, 139 for in are standard).
  3. Edit the zone table: each zone has a base price and a per-kg (or per-lb) rate.
  4. Read the chargeable weight and the cost for every zone.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is dimensional weight?

Carriers charge by whichever is greater: actual weight or (length x width x height) / divisor. Bulky light parcels are priced on their volume.

What divisor should I use?

5000 is the common IATA divisor for cm/kg; 139 is common for in/lb. Your carrier may differ, so the field is editable.

Are these real carrier prices?

No. Zone names and rates are editable samples. Enter your carrier's actual rate card for real quotes.
